# Copilot instructions

> **Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first. It is canonical.**
>
> How to work in this repository — phases, spec-first, versioning, hooks and CI
> controls, secret hygiene, documentation and the git workflow — lives there and
> applies to every AI client equally. Where this file and `AGENTS.md` disagree,
> `AGENTS.md` wins.

This file adds only what is specific to GitHub Copilot, and deliberately restates no
rule from `AGENTS.md`.

## Copilot-specific tooling

- No Copilot skills, agents or MCP servers are configured for this repository.
- If one is added later, its counterparts for the other clients move with it in the
